# robosuite

`checkout/` is a clean Git clone of local robosuite, fixed `5ce6643f3092639d08f7b0f90ed1c6a84f50552c`, upstream https://github.com/ARISE-Initiative/robosuite.
Only the environment depends on the source code without modifying the controller or robot configuration. Training data, asset download caches, model accounts are not here. Export and install source code by RoboCasa Docker Builder.
